view.name: Call room with chat pane
view.description: Video call room with the navbar controls and the open chat pane showing the team's sync messages and a message composer.

regions.label: Teal top bar: 'Video Call' title, unique user identifier, and icon-only call controls (hide video, mute, share screen, record, chat toggle, leave)
Large white video stage area, empty in the capture; small self-view video element anchored at bottom-left
Teal right-hand CHAT side panel: wheat-coloured message boxes with text, links, sender name+ID and timestamp; textarea composer with dark Send button

evidence.note: Call controls: Hide Video, Mute, Share screen, Record, chat toggle, leave (exit link to /)
Video stage, empty in capture (no remote participants rendered); self-view <video> 216x150 at bottom-left
Chat side channel panel beside the stage, toggled by header chat button (verified live)

evidence.quote: Morning all! Giving it 2 min for people to trickle in
evidence.note: Message box: text, then sender name with ID and timestamp below

evidence.quote: Board is here if you want to follow along
evidence.note: Message with raw URL link, no preview
Multi-line textarea composer with placeholder only, no label
Icon-only buttons have accessible names (Hide Video, Mute, Share screen, Record), likely native title hover labels; no rendered tooltip visible on live hover

patterns.rationale: Hovering in the live page did not render a visible custom tooltip; names may come from title attributes (native browser tooltip not captured).

evidence.note: Chat panel toggles show/hide via header button but is a fixed column, not a sliding overlay drawer
Top bar holds call controls, not navigation destinations

structure.layout: full-viewport call screen: fixed teal top bar with icon controls, large empty video stage left (~75%), fixed-width (360px) internally scrolling chat column right

aesthetics.typography: System UI stack (-apple-system / Helvetica/Arial fallback) everywhere: header title and ID 16px white, 'CHAT' heading 32px white, message bodies 12px black, sender/timestamp meta 10px, Send button 16px
aesthetics.typeScale: Flat, small: single 32px 'CHAT' heading, 16px header/button text, 12px message text, 10px metadata; all regular weight 400, no bold hierarchy

notes: Bootstrap-default look (bg-info teal #17a2b8, btn-dark #343a40, link blue #007bff) with Font Awesome filled icons in the top bar. Chat messages are wheat (#f5deb3) boxes with 6px radius and thin border, flush-left text with almost no padding; each shows body text, then 'Name (__id__id__) - 17th November, 2026 10:34 pm' in 10px. No avatars, no sender alignment differences. URLs are shown raw as blue links with no previews. The chat column scrolls internally and is pinned to the latest message; the composer is a square-cornered textarea with an adjoining full-height dark Send button. The video stage is entirely blank white in the capture; a 216x150 self-view <video> element sits at the bottom-left of the stage. Header shows a long random 'Unique Identifier' string instead of a user name. The chat icon toggles the chat column on and off (checked live), and the stage then fills the full width.
